_about: XIRPG's era edits for Journal (Kxteel, MIT, Nexus Mods FFXI mod 44): hide missions and quests after Treasures of Aht Urhgan. Applied by the launcher (Downloads tab > Journal) after you install Journal: each 'find' must appear exactly once, else nothing is changed. era.lua (ours) goes to addons/journal/data/era.lua.
